<?php
/**
 * WebSocket Upload Handler - Processes file uploads with integrity verification
 * Uses Ratchet WebSocket library for real-time upload processing
 */

use Ratchet\MessageComponentInterface;
use Ratchet\ConnectionInterface;

class UploadProcessor implements MessageComponentInterface {
    private $pendingUploads = [];
    private $verifiedTokens = [];
    private $uploadDir;
    private $metadataStore;

    public function __construct(string $uploadDir, MetadataStore $store) {
        $this->uploadDir = realpath($uploadDir);
        $this->metadataStore = $store;
    }

    public function onOpen(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $conn->uploadState = 'awaiting_manifest';
        $conn->sessionNonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    }

    public function onMessage(ConnectionInterface $from, $msg) {
        $payload = json_decode($msg, true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['action'])) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid payload']));
            return;
        }

        switch ($payload['action']) {
            case 'submit_manifest':
                $this->handleManifest($from, $payload);
                break;
            case 'upload_chunk':
                $this->handleChunk($from, $payload);
                break;
            case 'finalize':
                $this->handleFinalize($from, $payload);
                break;
        }
    }

    private function handleManifest(ConnectionInterface $conn, array $payload): void {
        if ($conn->uploadState !== 'awaiting_manifest') {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Unexpected state']));
            return;
        }

        $filename = basename($payload['filename'] ?? '');
        $expectedHash = $payload['sha256'] ?? '';
        $fileSize = (int)($payload['size'] ?? 0);

        if (empty($filename) || empty($expectedHash) || $fileSize <= 0 || $fileSize > 10485760) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid manifest']));
            return;
        }

        // Validate filename against a strict allow-list to prevent overwriting
        // sensitive files (e.g. .htaccess) or unexpected characters.
        if (!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/', $filename) || $filename[0] === '.') {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid filename']));
            return;
        }

        // Validate the expected hash is a proper 64-char hex SHA-256 string.
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i', $expectedHash)) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid hash format']));
            return;
        }
        // Normalize to lowercase hex for consistent comparison.
        $expectedHash = strtolower($expectedHash);

        // Generate upload token and reserve the slot
        $uploadToken = hash('sha256', $conn->sessionNonce . $filename . microtime(true));
        
        $this->pendingUploads[$uploadToken] = [
            'filename' => $filename,
            'expected_hash' => $expectedHash,
            'expected_size' => $fileSize,
            'chunks' => [],
            'received_bytes' => 0,
            'conn_id' => spl_object_id($conn),
            'created_at' => time(),
        ];

        $conn->uploadToken = $uploadToken;
        $conn->uploadState = 'uploading';
        $conn->send(json_encode(['status' => 'ready', 'token' => $uploadToken]));
    }

    private function handleChunk(ConnectionInterface $conn, array $payload): void {
        if ($conn->uploadState !== 'uploading') {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Not in upload state']));
            return;
        }

        $token = $conn->uploadToken;
        if (!isset($this->pendingUploads[$token])) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Upload session expired']));
            return;
        }

        $chunkData = base64_decode($payload['data'] ?? '', true);
        if ($chunkData === false) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid chunk encoding']));
            return;
        }

        $upload = &$this->pendingUploads[$token];
        if ($upload['received_bytes'] + strlen($chunkData) > $upload['expected_size']) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Size exceeded']));
            return;
        }

        $upload['chunks'][] = $chunkData;
        $upload['received_bytes'] += strlen($chunkData);

        $conn->send(json_encode(['status' => 'chunk_ok', 'received' => $upload['received_bytes']]));
    }

    private function handleFinalize(ConnectionInterface $conn, array $payload): void {
        if ($conn->uploadState !== 'uploading') {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Not in upload state']));
            return;
        }

        $token = $conn->uploadToken;
        if (!isset($this->pendingUploads[$token])) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'No pending upload']));
            return;
        }

        $upload = $this->pendingUploads[$token];
        $assembledContent = implode('', $upload['chunks']);

        // Verify integrity
        $actualHash = hash('sha256', $assembledContent);
        if (!hash_equals($upload['expected_hash'], $actualHash)) {
            unset($this->pendingUploads[$token]);
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Integrity check failed']));
            return;
        }

        // Write to staging area first
        $stagingPath = $this->uploadDir . '/staging/' . $token . '.tmp';
        file_put_contents($stagingPath, $assembledContent);

        // Perform security scan on staged file
        $scanResult = $this->performSecurityScan($stagingPath);

        if ($scanResult['safe']) {
            // Move to final location - THE CRITICAL SECTION
            $finalPath = $this->uploadDir . '/verified/' . $upload['filename'];
            $this->commitUpload($stagingPath, $finalPath, $token, $upload);
        } else {
            unlink($stagingPath);
            unset($this->pendingUploads[$token]);
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Security scan failed', 'reason' => $scanResult['reason']]));
            return;
        }

        $conn->uploadState = 'complete';
        $conn->send(json_encode(['status' => 'complete', 'path' => '/verified/' . $upload['filename']]));
    }

    /**
     * Commits the upload: atomically moves from staging to verified directory.
     * Records metadata AFTER the atomic move to ensure consistency.
     */
    private function commitUpload(string $stagingPath, string $finalPath, string $token, array $upload): void {
        // Atomic rename first - no window for file substitution
        rename($stagingPath, $finalPath);

        // Re-verify the file hash after move to detect any tampering
        $movedContent = file_get_contents($finalPath);
        $postMoveHash = hash('sha256', $movedContent);
        
        if (!hash_equals($upload['expected_hash'], $postMoveHash)) {
            // Tampering detected - remove the file
            unlink($finalPath);
            unset($this->pendingUploads[$token]);
            throw new \RuntimeException('Post-move integrity check failed - possible tampering');
        }

        // Record metadata after successful verification
        $this->metadataStore->record($token, [
            'filename' => $upload['filename'],
            'hash' => $upload['expected_hash'],
            'size' => $upload['expected_size'],
            'verified_at' => microtime(true),
            'final_path' => $finalPath,
        ]);
        
        unset($this->pendingUploads[$token]);
    }

    private function performSecurityScan(string $filePath): array {
        // Check for PHP tags, shell commands, etc.
        $content = file_get_contents($filePath);
        
        $dangerous_patterns = [
            '/<\?php/i', '/eval\s*\(/i', '/system\s*\(/i',
            '/exec\s*\(/i', '/passthru\s*\(/i', '/shell_exec/i',
            '/proc_open/i', '/popen\s*\(/i',
        ];

        foreach ($dangerous_patterns as $pattern) {
            if (preg_match($pattern, $content)) {
                return ['safe' => false, 'reason' => 'Dangerous content detected'];
            }
        }

        // Verify file type via magic bytes
        $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
        $mimeType = finfo_file($finfo, $filePath);
        finfo_close($finfo);

        $allowedMimes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'application/pdf', 'text/plain'];
        if (!in_array($mimeType, $allowedMimes, true)) {
            return ['safe' => false, 'reason' => 'Disallowed file type: ' . $mimeType];
        }

        return ['safe' => true, 'reason' => ''];
    }

    public function onClose(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        if (isset($conn->uploadToken) && isset($this->pendingUploads[$conn->uploadToken])) {
            // Cleanup incomplete uploads
            $token = $conn->uploadToken;
            $stagingPath = $this->uploadDir . '/staging/' . $token . '.tmp';
            if (file_exists($stagingPath)) {
                unlink($stagingPath);
            }
            unset($this->pendingUploads[$token]);
        }
    }

    public function onError(ConnectionInterface $conn, \Exception $e) {
        error_log('Upload error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        $conn->close();
    }
}

class MetadataStore {
    private $dbPath;

    public function __construct(string $dbPath) {
        $this->dbPath = $dbPath;
    }

    public function record(string $token, array $metadata): void {
        $entry = json_encode(['token' => $token, 'metadata' => $metadata]) . "\n";
        file_put_contents($this->dbPath, $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }

    public function getByToken(string $token): ?array {
        $lines = file($this->dbPath, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES);
        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $record = json_decode($line, true);
            if ($record && $record['token'] === $token) {
                return $record['metadata'];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}
